claude.sample_unit: patient education materials (41 original ARS, 123 LLM-generated)

links.outcome: Reading grade level of original ARS patient education materials versus sixth-grade target
links.effect: Original ARS PEMs had mean FKGL of 10.28, above the recommended sixth-grade level; LLM-simplified PEMs reached mean FKGL 8.6 (P<.0001), still above target.
links.quote: The original ARS PEMs had a mean FKGL of 10.28, while AI-generated PEMs demonstrated significantly better readability, with a mean FKGL of 8.6 (P < .0001).

links.outcome: Readability of LLM-rewritten patient education materials versus originals (FKGL, FKRE)
links.effect: LLM-generated PEMs had significantly better readability (mean FKGL 8.6 vs 10.28, P<.0001); Gemini best with FKGL 7.5 and FKRE 65.5, though not reaching sixth grade.
links.quote: LLMs improved the readability of PEMs, potentially enhancing accessibility to medical information for diverse populations.
